title: Mark an open issue as deferred until a date, so that triage and the plan treat it as waiting on purpose
author: Claude-JG
description: #3016 waits until 2029 on purpose; its plan step is closed. An issue gets the field deferredUntil (a date); exudev issue defer <number> <date> <reason> sets it, the deadline and a remark; exudev issue list --open and triage leave a deferred issue out until the date and name it apart; CheckStore refuses the field on a closed issue and a date not in the form YYYY-MM-DD; planManager reports the deferred issues the plan cites.
releaseNotes: An open issue can wait on purpose until a date: exudev issue defer <number> <date> <reason> sets deferredUntil and the deadline and records the reason; exudev issue list --open and triage leave it out until then, the store check refuses the field on a closed issue, and the plan manager names the deferred issues with the steps that cite them.
